baselines: B-BROWSE-COLD (ID B-BROWSE-COLD): Cold browsing baseline with no inheritance: per task cost = browser_steps_cold (each step = one browser interaction + verify) counted via same honest browser_steps instrument, no resolve/bind/alias/catalog/fetch cost, no UNKNOWN (always attempts). Train/test partitioned by resource trajectory-grouped (families as resampling units, not independent transitions). 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap + 5000 block-permutation with family as block. Preserves prior honests without BrowserGym dependency; live Available may be false correctly disclosed as synthetic gate not MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Synthetic-to-live gap remains dominant validity threat and explicitly bounded to disjoint-alphabet fixing vs WebArena-Verified v2/WebGym 300k heterogeneity.

State and observation representation — synthetic non-oracle with disjoint holdout: derived_context = ONLY mechanism template strings and observed key sets with canonical k sorted keys after alias resolution, plus train-A registry; MUST NOT contain novelty_fraction, length_label, target_resource_id, or expected_key_set. Alias/catalog/index fit train-A only; test-B resources held out at trajectory level (whole trajectories of B never indexed). Correctness requires exact expected key-set equality canonicalized after alias resolution (not value-only bounds_equal), with per-task expected key set held-out. Audit verifies no forbidden reads via harness signatures and manifest disjointness. Representation loss disclosed: synthetic alphabets deliberately disjoint to isolate factorization from lexical similarity; prior Laplace smoothing / hash-truncated DOM bias addressed via trajectory-grouped bootstrap and shuffled null |rho|<0.20 gap, with valid null bias check |perm-mean|<0.05 (analogous to prior |perm-analytic|<0.03, |null|<0.1 requirement).

Action, cost, and pipeline isolation with honest sum counters: honest total per trajectory = sum(resolve + bind + verify + freshness + browser_steps) instrumented integers with per-trajectory hard reset, no jitter, no global scaling n*3200 or f*6.0, within-family std>0 verified, |rho_shuffled|<0.20 p>=0.20, trajectory-grouped. Build cost counted separately offline vector-ops for M_total(f)=build + f*mean_per_task. Browser_steps counted as steps actually taken (0% novelty ~1-2 steps, 100% novelty ~ length). Retrieval baseline includes per-query embedding counter. All costs share same instrument. Per-family novelty/length stratification preserves holdout.

Orthogonal families and novelty framing: 36 families cover header/body/query/auth analogues but deliberately orthogonalized Jaccard<0.30 disjoint alphabets to prevent Jaccard>=0.6 alias rescue leakage from prior 17-deep tunnel; per-task novelty fraction is independent variable (0,25,50,75,100%) crossed with task length bins (short/medium/long); pooled and per-stratum rho calculations decouple novelty vs length via partial controls. Audit checks family manifest Jaccard<0.30 and alphabet disjointness. Novelty 0% tasks require zero novel bindings (all resolvable from A), 100% require all bindings from B (never observed).

Protocol deterministic revisable with strong nulls: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(42) and deterministic hashlib.sha256 for jitter and permutation shards; family-stratified bootstrap 5000 and block-permutation 5000 trajectory-grouped by family (unit=trajectory, not transition). Stratified resampling preserves family/novelty/length proportions. No post-hoc retuning of thresholds after seeing rho; ECE bins fixed 5 adaptive, UNKNOWN threshold fixed <0.80, softmax temp 0.15 fixed.

Determinism and seeds: Seeds 42 for all stochastic operations; deterministic hashing for jitter and shard assignment not Python hash(); each task evaluated once per baseline paired design; M_total bootstrap resamples trajectories with family stratification.

Holdout and leakage controls: 36 families x resources partitioned trajectory-grouped train-A/test-B; catalog/index/hierarchical fit train-A only; UNKNOWN gate derived solely from softmax confidence over train-A vocabulary; correct-family rule derives eligibility from parsed template family vs observed canonical family key-sets never hidden expected; audit verifies zero forbidden reads of test-B resource id or novelty_fraction, catalog never sees test, and per-family cross leakage 0/192. No site-identity leakage because families are synthetic labels not site ids.

Sample counts: Novelty strata 5 levels x ~38 tasks each = ~192 pooled synthetic tasks (36 families) primary, plus no-applicable 12, empty 6, exact-match 12 calibration = ~222 per pipeline. Pipelines 4 (BROWSE, FLAT-RAG-K5, SPIDER-RESIDUAL, RANDOM) => ~888 task evaluations paired per comparison for McNemar-equivalent bootstrap. Novelty 0% N>=30, 100% N>=30, middle strata N>=30 each; per-length quantiles similarly >=30. No live browser calls if synthetic gate; if Runtime unblocks BrowserGym live_available flag triggers separate live replication with 1280x720 CDP AX>10 logging but not required for this bounded synthetic gate.

Verification, metrics, and economics: per-task correct flag under exact expected key-set equality; UNKNOWN counted as correct abstention on no-applicable; false_accept = accepted but wrong key-set or should abstain; ECE 5 adaptive bins derived confidence bootstrap CI 5000; rho_novelty Spearman between honest cost and novelty fraction, rho_length between honest cost and task length (total steps), both Spearman with family-stratified bootstrap CI and block-permutation p; per-stratum rho_length conditioned on novelty strata and length quantiles; M_total(f) = build_cost + f*mean_per_task_cost via honest counters modeled at $0.00002 per vector-op, reported at f=10 and f=100 with bootstrap CI for saving%; Pareto requires SPIDER dominates both BROWSE and RAG at both f. Blinding: thresholds frozen before observation, no outcome-bearing tuning.

Blinding and oracle prohibition: No pipeline tuned on test-B resources nor on novelty_fraction; held-out B resources excluded from catalog training and from derived_context; no outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN; honest counters validated before correlation tests.
